title: Jubilant Australian Ground Pistachios Pavlova
description: A rich and decadent dessert featuring ground pistachios and a crispy meringue topping.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large mixing bowl, whip the eggs until stiff peaks form.
In a separate bowl, mix together the sugar, ground pistachios, and kosher salt.
Fold the sugar mixture into the whipped eggs until well combined.
Add the softened butter and vanilla extract, and fold until smooth.
Spoon the meringue mixture onto the prepared baking sheet, forming a large circle.
Bake for 1 hour, then reduce the heat to 120°C (250°F) and continue baking for another 2 hours.
Allow the meringue to cool completely on the baking sheet.
To assemble the pavlova, place the cooled meringue on a serving plate.
Top the meringue with the brine-soaked fresh raspberries, then sprinkle with icing sugar.
Finish with whipped cream and a sprinkle of ground pistachios.
